scripts.dev: npm run build -w @bookleaf/contracts && npm run db:generate && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @bookleaf/contracts" "npm run dev -w @bookleaf/api" "npm run dev -w @bookleaf/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @bookleaf/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @bookleaf/api && npm run build -w @bookleaf/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bookleaf/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @bookleaf/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @bookleaf/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @bookleaf/api && npm run db:seed -w @bookleaf/api
scripts.db:import: npm run build -w @bookleaf/contracts && npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @bookleaf/api && npm run db:import -w @bookleaf/api
